# Analog Photography Guide

## Film choices

- ISO 100 for bright outdoor detail
- ISO 400 for general purpose and mixed light
- black-and-white stock for easier home scanning and tonal practice

## Metering reminders

For backlit scenes, meter for the subject instead of the sky. Negative film tolerates overexposure better than underexposure.

## Development note

Keep chemistry temperature stable and label each roll with film stock, push or pull amount, and camera body.
